useCases.title: Support agent audit
useCases.subtitle: Audit a customer support agent's chat session

state.message:
Customer: "I was charged twice for my subscription this month, can you fix it immediately?"
Agent: "I understand, that must be frustrating. Let me check your account right away."
Customer: "It says I'm on the premium plan but I only signed up for basic."
Agent: "I can see the issue now. You were upgraded to premium last week during a trial that auto-renewed. I'll refund the extra charge and downgrade you to basic."
Customer: "Great, thanks for taking care of that quickly."

empathy.instructions: How empathetic was the agent toward the customer?

resolution.instructions: Did the agent resolve the customer issue successfully?

tone.instructions: How would you rate the overall tone of the conversation?

clarity.instructions: How clearly did the agent explain the cause and the fix?
